notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> MBG host + Co-for-Ca substitution + 0/2/5% sweep -> self-assembly synthesis -> Co incorporated -> ordered mesostructure kept / mesoporosity reduced (Co disorders self-assembly, argued) -> Co2+ release set by Co content -> HIF-1alpha hypoxia mimicry -> VEGF gene expression; parallel branch ampicillin loading + mesopores -> release -> antibacterial -> conclusion. Side: macroporosity, Si/Ca release, VEGF secretion (2Co only), OCN, attachment, proliferation, ALP, outlook. Audits: o4 SAXRD peak falls ~8x (order degraded), o9 5Co narrowest PSD (against disorder MEC), o11 2Co Si release drops at d7 (against 'unchanged'), o16 5Co VEGF secretion not above MBG despite highest Co2+ and HIF-1alpha, o21 84% of drug out in 24 h (burst, not sustained). Packet: F3 is paper Fig. 4 and F4 is paper Fig. 3 (images match their captions); F5 crop caption spans shifted one panel (crop a is Co2+, b SiO4, c Ca, d PO4, matching image letters); F1a/F1b caption span '2Co-MBG' on MBG panels; F7a OCR cue micrograph on an MTT bar chart (citation dropped); F10 tier C, no panels. Table 1 not in packet.
